query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64",
                  COALESCE(SUM(s.category_id * o.id), 0) AS "checksum!: i64",
                  COALESCE(MAX(o.updated_at), '') AS "updated_at!: String"
           FROM operation o
           JOIN operation_split s ON s.operation_id = o.id
           WHERE s.category_id IS NOT NULL
